what: Prompt R3d (2026-11-16): every change to prompts/system_prompt.md, the NORMAL turn's prompt, since fixture v8 (52f5510). Undoing the list, newest first, gives v8's prompt byte for byte (Tests/test_agent_payload_equivalence.py). A draft chat's turn keeps prompts/draft_frozen/system_prompt.md.

changes.why: P1 item 2: every comparison of named players goes to the code-built comparison, injured or flagged players included
changes.old: A comparison of two or more named players over the coming gameweeks goes to `compare_players`, with every player's id in `player_ids`.
changes.new: Any question comparing two or more named players — "X or Y", "who is the better pick", "how do they stack up" — goes to `compare_players` with every player's id in `player_ids`, injured or flagged players included (its answer shows the flag first); never compare players from their player cards.

changes.why: P2 item 3: a swap instruction is previewed at once
changes.old: A squad-change preview from `set_my_squad` comes back with its text written by code and shown with the preview card.
changes.new: A squad-change preview from `set_my_squad` comes back with its text written by code and shown with the preview card. Any message naming a player to take out and a player to bring in — sell / buy, swap, replace, "X out, Y in", "bring in X for Y" — is an instruction: resolve both and preview it with `set_my_squad` at once, never argue or ask first; the code-built preview shows the predicted gain, so a poor move is visible there.

changes.why: P3 item 1: a number of gameweeks is never a number of transfers
changes.old: a number of transfers the user names as `max_transfers`)
changes.new: a number of transfers the user names as `max_transfers` — a number of gameweeks is `horizon`, never `max_transfers`)
